ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 120

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 13

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

6. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 100
   C. 11
   D. 50

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

14. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 1

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

17. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

18. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 9
   D. 13

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

20. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

21. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

22. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

23. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

24. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
